text: As I go through life, I realized that having any concrete plans that like last multiple years where there is no flexibility, no adaptability, and everything is so specific, so rigid is not the way to go. The world is very random, especially in this age with AI and automation and agents. Everything is changing. And even on the political landscape, right? You got like wars starting, bombings. [music] A few months ago, I was living in Dubai. I thought I would live Dubai for the next couple of years at least. And then boom, bombs start dropping and suddenly I'm living in Poland, right? You cannot really plan anything. Tomorrow, you might meet a person that might completely change your life. Could be a business partner, could be [music] your future wife, could be someone who introduces you to someone. Or the people in your life, you know, might betray you, something might change, your company might get shut down, might go bankrupt. You never know what's going to happen. You really need to be like a light on your feet, you know, like a boxer but in your life. So obviously, you need some direction of where to go. You need some idea of what goals you have, what values you have, what [music] you want to achieve. But you cannot be so rigid. You cannot be so stiff. You have to be adaptable. You have to be flexible. Like Bruce Lee said, be like water.
